niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, structured interfaces that feel complete, intentional, and easy to scan. They consistently like clear hierarchy, well-populated content, balanced sectioning, restrained typography, and softer color treatment over loud or chaotic presentation. In many settings and onboarding flows they favor calm, contemporary, lightly styled UIs with rounded but controlled components, soft pastel or muted accents, and reduced decorative clutter. They also respond positively to interfaces that feel production-ready, coherent, and purposefully organized rather than sparse, unfinished, overly promotional, or mechanically fragmented.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that feel complete, populated, and intentionally filled out, with multiple visible options or content blocks rather than sparse, empty, or cut-off layouts.
Prefers strong structural organization with clearly separated sections, full-width grouping, visible hierarchy, and an easy top-to-bottom reading flow.
Prefers interfaces that look refined, balanced, consistent, and production-ready rather than rough, awkward, unfinished, or compositionally uneven.
Prefers gentler, more restrained color accents such as pastel or muted multicolor treatments over louder, harsher, or more saturated accent usage.
Prefers calmer typographic hierarchy with smaller or more controlled titles and less shouty emphasis, avoiding oversized headings or overly forceful labels.
Prefers a soft, calm, contemporary visual mood with gentle contrast and understated presentation rather than severe, mechanical, or aggressively utilitarian styling.
Prefers crisp row-based lists with dividers and standalone items over bulky card stacks, chunky grouped blocks, or overly compartmentalized containers.
Prefers minimal decorative overhead and fewer competing visual elements, such as less dominant hero imagery, fewer extra widgets, and more focus on core content.
